That means we cover areas like Product Management, UI/UX, Engineering, Testing, and Maintenance. Therefore, come join us and be part of the tech community inside our firm.â¯ Location: Bucharest About the role As part of BearingPoint Products, you will join a product development organization where every colleague contributes to the success of our products end-to-end. You will work alongside experienced Product Owners, Project Managers, Business Analysts, UX Designers, Developers and QA Engineers, gaining hands-on exposure to the full software development lifecycle. Through mentorship, collaboration and practical experience, you will develop both technical and business understanding while contributing to real product initiatives. We are looking for motivated individuals who are passionate about technology, eager to learn modern cloud technologies and interested in understanding how software products create value for customers and support business processes. Primary Functions and Tasks: Participate in the design, development, testing and maintenance of software products and digital solutions; Develop cloud-based applications using modern technologies such as SAP BTP, Cloud Foundry, Node.js and SAP UI5; Collaborate with Product Owners, Project Managers and Business Analysts to understand requirements and deliver high-quality solutions; Support the implementation of new product features and enhancements; Participate in Agile ceremonies and collaborative product development activities; Gain understanding customer needs, business processes and how technology creates value for organizations; Learn and apply software engineering best practices, quality standards and development methodologies. We are looking for:â¯ Graduate in Computer Science, Software Engineering or equivalent; Some previous experience with one or more of the following technologies: object-oriented programming languages, SQL, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS; Personal or University projects to prove previous experience; Interest in business processes, commercial topics and understanding customer needs; Ability to connect technical solutions with business requirements; Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; Curiosity to learn both technical and functional aspects of enterprise software products; Very good English; Client-oriented, strong analytical and conceptual thinking; Communicative, highly adaptive, team player and eager to learn new technologies; Entrepreneurial attitude, enthusiasm for new approaches and innovative solutions. Offer: Compensation package: Our compensation package includes a fixed salary with yearly evaluation and quarterly performance-related bonus, meal tickets, Easter and Christmas gift vouchers, as well as seniority, referral bonus, and peer-to-peer recognition. Health and Wellbeing: Our benefits package includes extra paid vacation days, hybrid working model, quality private medical subscription for employee and their families, and gym options. Professional growth: A learning-oriented organization with customized training paths (a mix between technical, functional and soft skills, as well as German and French language courses), certifications, valuable e-learning solution and firm-wide development programs. â¯ For more information, please visit: www.bearingpoint.com www.linkedin.com/company/bearingpoint instagram.com/bearingpointromania facebook.com/BearingPointRomania â¯About BearingPoint BearingPoint is an independent management and technology consultancy with European roots and a global reach. We help businesses transform by combining deep industry expertise with strong capabilities in strategy, operations, and technology. Dedicated SAP and Microsoft transformation units, a strong focus on AI, and outcome-based products enable us to provide tailored, innovative solutions that create measurable and sustainable value. In addition to our core consulting operations, we run two joint ventures. Arcwide, our joint venture with IFS, specializes in business transformation enabled by IFS technology. BearingPoint North America, our joint venture with ABeam Consulting, focuses on consulting excellence and business transformation built on SAP. BearingPoint works with many of the world’s leading companies and public-sector organizations. Together with its strategic alliance partner ABeam Consulting, the firm brings together more than 15,000 professionals and serves clients in over 70 countries, delivering seamless business transformation, strengthening performance, and driving sustainable impact. BearingPoint is recognized among TIME World’s Best Companies and Forbes World’s Best Employers. The firm is also a certified B Corporation, committed to responsible business and creating long-term value for organizations, people, and society. Together with our colleagues from Portugal, the Czech Republic and India, we are part of BearingPoint’s Cross-Shore Enablement Hub (CSH), which offers a wide range of expertise. We are present in 6 cities in Romania (Bucharest, Brasov, Cluj-Napoca, Iasi, Sibiu and Timisoara) and our team has more than 850 employees. Together, we are more than business. Join us.
